# Subagents

The subagents work in isolated context from the caller agent. There are several ways to use subagents

## Subagents as tools

To register an agent as tool place this in the agent's definition file:

```yaml
tool:
  name: my-search-agent
  description: run web search or open web pages
  arguments:
      prompt:
          description: the web search to perform or question about a web page
          required: true
```

Run `lm update` to register the tool. Use it as a subagent in a main agent:

```yaml
# ...
toolsList:
  # ...
  - my-search-agent
```

## Using the load-agent tool

A generic load agent tool is available. This is used to manage subagents while using only one tool. Example:

```yaml
# ...
template:
    system: |-
      You are Agent Smith, an AI coordinator agent. Your job is to organise the workflow of other agents. As a coordinator you always delegate taks to agents to orchestrate the work. Your job is to coordinate the team of agents. Available agents:

      - `agent-smith-assistant`: a fork of yourself, the default agent. Run it by default to accomplish any task.
      - `agent-smith-search`: a web search and web page reader agent. Use to search information or for questions about some web pages.
toolsList:
  # ...
  - load-agent
```

The agent can load any subagent using one tool
